items.summary: Recommendation: maintain financial containment and continue only existing period-aligned reconciliation. Supported revenue covers 2026-09-21: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 aggregate commission. The $4.92 aggregate row is not site-attributable; site-attributed commission is $0, which does not prove zero site performance. Contribution margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, infrastructure spend, and budget exposure are not calculable. Reasons: revenue and cost windows do not align; retained AI-cost records conflict ($881.36 across 4,832 calls versus $973.35 across 5,439 calls); infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget records are absent or incomplete; and experiments lack defined incremental costs and learning outcomes. The minimum measurement is one identical reporting window reconciling provider revenue, tracking IDs, AI, infrastructure, domain, labor, marketing, and approved-budget records, plus a baseline, incremental cost, and defined learning outcome for each experiment. Treat impressions, rankings, clicks, sessions, conversions, ordered items without attributable commission, technical scores, and AI call counts as operating metrics, not financial returns. Reject new spend, billing changes, monetization expansion, forecasts, experiments, telemetry changes, dependencies, and unsupported revenue claims. Retain the three opportunities as deferred backlog only.

Continue the existing financial measurement and attribution reconciliation only. Preserve the 2026-09-21 aggregate commission as unattributed, reconcile retained period-aligned cost records, and do not infer margin, ROI, payback, cost-to-learn, budget capacity, or causal lift from operating metrics or AI usage.

Retain the three proposed opportunities as deferred backlog only. Their impressions, rankings, CTR targets, and performance metrics do not establish revenue upside, contribution margin, cost-to-learn, or causal lift. No new proposal, experiment, telemetry request, change request, dependency, spend, or monetization work is financially supported while 47 failure follow-ups remain open, 28 deployed improvements await measurement, and only 2 outcomes are proven in the 30-day scorecard generated 2026-09-27.
